register: Use clear international French, concise infinitive action labels and consistent vous/votre when direct address is necessary; avoid regional slang. Preserve 200 OK, URLs, paths, index.html, HTTP, CORS, SPA, IPv4/IPv6 and code/port examples. Inflect terminology naturally. Never imply HTTPS, uploads, public-internet access or indefinite iOS background serving. Distinguish launcher/controller and the HTTP server.

background.meaning: Android/desktop policy differs; iOS stops on background.

folder.meaning: A user-selected serving folder, not an arbitrary system directory.

lan.meaning: Access on the local network does not imply public internet access.

launcher.meaning: Browser surface controls a separately installed native server.

listing.meaning: List files when no index.html exists, not upload permission.

port.meaning: Numeric port; 0 selects an available port.

readonly.meaning: Serving does not grant file modification.

server.meaning: The native app serves files; the extension launches or controls it.
server.preferred: serveur HTTP / mettre des fichiers à disposition

start.meaning: Explicitly start the listener; opening a launcher is distinct.

stop.meaning: Stops serving, retaining the selected folder and settings.
